errors.evidence: The values for Welt-BIP and Welthandel in the 2000s are 3.9% and 5.4%, respectively, not 5.4% and 5.3%.

errors.text_span: Im Jahr 2010 nahmen die Werte eine niedrige Verbesserung (2,2) auf.
errors.evidence: The value of 2.2% corresponds to the Industrieproduktion Deutschlands in the 2010s, not an overall improvement.

The description does not mention the legend, which identifies the colors as Welt-BIP (dark green), Welthandel (light green), Exporte Deutschland (dark blue), and Industrieproduktion Deutschland (light blue).
